changes.reason: Custom policies receive each actual failed attempt once. Optional error-only classification preserves exhaustion recovery without evaluating a synthetic earlier attempt. The default policy retains its existing classification and attempt limit.

kubernetes.reason: This separates host-independent retry error classification from the attempt budget. It adds no Kubernetes Node Host capability, storage or lifecycle requirement.
constraints: Existing backoff, cancellation and provider runtime constraints remain unchanged. No deployment or provider certification is claimed.

aws-lambda.reason: This separates host-independent retry error classification from the attempt budget. It adds no Lambda Host capability, storage or lifecycle requirement.
constraints: Existing backoff, cancellation and provider runtime constraints remain unchanged. No deployment or provider certification is claimed.

constraints: Existing backoff, cancellation and provider runtime constraints remain unchanged. No deployment or provider certification is claimed.
